item.title: Free Minimalist Phone Wallpapers: Japan's 72 Microseasons, Four Seasons in Light and Dark
item.description: Four free phone wallpapers from Japan's 72 microseasons — first cherry blossoms, first lotus blossoms, chrysanthemums, and the start of winter. Each shows the name of the microseason in Japanese, written vertically, with its reading and meaning. Light and dark versions. Designed in Japan by GLOBAL INNER DIVINE.
